qualification.education_qualification: Ph.D. in Materials Engineering/ Polymer Engineering/ Biotechnology/ Biomedical Engineering or allied branches
qualification.details: Ph.D. in Materials Engineering/ Polymer Engineering/ Biotechnology/ Biomedical Engineering or any other allied branches. Minimum two research publications in SCI-indexed journals having a high impact factor in the field of Materials Engineering/ Biomaterials and Polymer Engineering/ Biomedical Engineering or Pharmaceutical science and drug delivery. Only articles in which the applicant is the first author will be considered for screening. Ability to demonstrate working capabilities with material characterization tools, including SEM, TEM, XRD, TGA, DSC, and HPLC. Desirable: Industrial experience with a strong background in one or more areas within Bio-composite materials, including the synthesis & characterization of nanomaterials, pharmaceutical science/ drug delivery, as well as relevant experience in the biomedical field, encompassing in-vitro & in-vivo testing.

salary_details.details: Rs. 80,000 per month for the 1st and 2nd year.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Post Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Roorkee Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 15 September 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Post-Doctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. in Materials Engineering, Polymer Engineering, Biotechnology, Biomedical Engineering, or allied branches. Additionally, a minimum of two SCI-indexed publications as the first author is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 80,000 per month for both the first and second year of their tenure.

faq.question: Q4. How should candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email. A single PDF file containing a covering letter, detailed CV, list of publications, research statement, and justification of suitability must be sent to the specified email addresses.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Post-Doctoral Fellow recruitment at IIT Roorkee is MIED/PDF/2096.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Roorkee is a temporary role, offering a fixed-term opportunity for research.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any age relaxations mentioned for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits or age relaxations for this Post-Doctoral Fellow position.

faq.question: Q9. What are the essential skills required for the Post-Doctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess the ability to work with material characterization tools such as SEM, TEM, XRD, TGA, DSC, and HPLC. Experience in specific research areas is also desirable.
